mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has stabilized at -28.1% in the most recent week after declining to -31.0% two weeks prior, indicating a floor effect. This reversal of the downward trend signals emerging consumer confidence and will drive RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks as the stabilization persists.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 2.9 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days remains below -28% or declines further below the t-0w level of -28.1%.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has improved from -37.0% to -33.4% over four weeks, indicating gradual return to public transportation use. When TRANSIT crosses above -33% and sustains that level, commuter confidence triggers increased discretionary retail visits within a one-week lag, directly elevating RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -33% and sustains for one week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 3.6 points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within one week of TRANSIT crossing -33%, or TRANSIT falls back below -35% before the one-week window closes.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has strengthened from -24.6% to -21.6% over four weeks. This sustained improvement in workplace attendance over two weeks triggers a two-week lagged increase in retail foot traffic as workers resume commuting patterns and incidental shopping behavior, driving RETAIL_REC higher.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES improves by more than 2 points week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved 3.0 points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over weeks t+1 to t+2 does not exceed the mean of the last four weeks, or WORKPLACES reverses and declines by more than 1.5 points in either of the next two weeks.

evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at -23.1% and RESIDENTIAL at +12.1% in t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not increase relative to the prior 28-day mean, or PARKS rebounds above -20% before the four-week window closes.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over weeks t+1 to t+2 does not increase, or GROCERY_PHARM falls back below 0% before the two-week window closes.
